title: Unpaid Instalments, Grace and Termination of a ShieldCare Plan
content:
## Clause 1: grace must run in full

A Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is not terminated for non-payment before the plan's
premium grace days have run in full from the first day of the unpaid premium period. Premium
grace days are counted as calendar days from the first day of the unpaid period, which counts
as day zero, with no business-day adjustment. The first day of the unpaid premium period as
recorded on the plan's premium history is the authority for the count, correlated to the plan
itself, and the comparison is that the termination may not fall earlier than the end of grace;
a termination on the boundary day itself is inside the rule.

### Both sides of the grace count

On a plan carrying 21 grace days, with the unpaid period beginning on day zero, the plan may
not be terminated on the twentieth day after that first day; on the twenty-first it may.
Calendar days are counted throughout, so a weekend inside the run is counted like any other
day.

## Clause 2: the late fee

The provision that the plan's late fee is billed once when grace runs out is **no longer in force**: both the occasion on which the fee is billed and the amount it comes to now rest on
the current basis, and that basis is not restated here. The rest of the clause stands: the
premium already owed stays owed after termination.

## Clause 3: claims against an unpaid period

A claim whose incident day falls inside an unpaid period is not paid until that period is
settled. A claim whose incident day falls after termination is not paid at all.

## Clause 4: settling on the day of termination

Where the customer settles everything outstanding on the day of termination or before it, the
plan is left in force and the termination is not booked.

## Clause 5: no reinstatement

A terminated plan is not reinstated. The customer is sold a fresh plan if the item still meets
the admission rules.

## Points of judgement

| Fact recorded | The rule's answer |
| --- | --- |
| Grace days not yet run in full | The plan is not terminated for non-payment |
| Everything outstanding settled on the day of termination | The plan stays in force and no termination is booked |
| Incident day inside a period still unpaid | The claim is not paid until that period is settled |
| Incident day after termination | The claim is not paid at all |
| Plan already terminated, item still admissible | A fresh plan is sold; the terminated plan is not reinstated |

superseded_clauses: The plan's late fee is billed once
